content.title: What is Lorem Ipsum and Why Use It?
content.intro: Lorem Ipsum is the standard 'dummy text' used in printing and typesetting. Since the 1500s, designers have used this Latin-based passage to focus on visual layout rather than the meaning of the text.
content.history_text: Contrary to popular belief, it is not random text. It has roots in a piece of classical Latin literature from 45 BC, 'De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum' (The Extremes of Good and Evil) by Cicero.
content.why_text: If you write 'Content will be placed here' in a draft, the reviewer will try to read the text and get distracted from the design itself (colors, spacing, fonts). Lorem Ipsum eliminates this distraction.

content.title: Double Your Productivity with the Pomodoro Technique
content.intro: The Pomodoro Technique is a popular time management method developed by Francesco Cirillo in the late 1980s. The principle is simple: break down large tasks into short, timed intervals (usually 25 minutes) separated by short breaks. Toolio Pomodoro Timer is designed to help you apply this technique digitally.
content.how_title: How to Use the Pomodoro Technique?
content.how_step_1: Pick a Task: Identify a single task you need to focus on (e.g., writing a report).
content.how_step_2: Start the Timer: Start the 25-minute timer in 'Focus' mode.
content.how_step_3: Focus: Work solely on that task until the timer rings. Put your phone on silent.
content.how_step_4: Short Break: Take a 5-minute 'Short Break' when the alarm sounds. Stretch, drink water.
content.how_step_5: Repeat the Cycle: After 4 Pomodoro cycles, take a 15-30 minute 'Long Break'.
content.benefits_text: Continuous work leads to mental fatigue (burnout). The Pomodoro technique keeps your mind fresh with frequent breaks, prevents procrastination, and improves your time management skills.

content.title: Internet Speed Test and Connection Performance Analysis
content.p1: Do you think your internet connection is slow? Are you really getting the speed promised by your Internet Service Provider (ISP)? Toolio Internet Speed Test measures the real performance of your fiber, ADSL, VDSL, or mobile (4G/5G) connection directly from your browser in seconds.
content.h2: What Do Speed Test Terms Mean?
content.li1: The most important part of internet usage. It is the bandwidth used when browsing websites, watching Netflix/YouTube, or downloading files. Higher values (e.g., 35 Mbps, 100 Mbps) provide faster loading.
content.li2: The speed of sending data from your computer to the internet. This line is used when making Zoom calls, posting photos to Instagram, or sending emails.
content.li3: The time it takes for data to travel from your device to the server and back. Especially in online games (Valorant, CS:GO, PUBG) and video calls, a low Ping value (preferably under 20ms) prevents freezing and lag.
content.h_tips: How to Measure Internet Speed Correctly?
content.tips_p: To get the most accurate result, pay attention to the following before starting the test:
content.tip1: Close applications running background downloads (Steam, Torrent, etc.).
content.tip2: Connect to the modem with a cable (Ethernet) if possible. If using Wi-Fi, stay close to the modem.
content.tip3: Ensure other devices connected to the same network (TV, Phone) are not using the internet heavily during the test.
content.h_faq: What Should Ideal Internet Speed Be?
content.faq_p: It depends on your usage. 25 Mbps is generally sufficient for watching 4K video, 5 Mbps for HD video, and 10 Mbps for standard browsing. For online games, low Ping value is more important than speed.
